Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Ravindra Kumar
Message:
feat(runtime): eight mechanisms the catalog stated only as prose

The doctrine layer names these; nothing enforced them. Each is now a
standalone stdlib script with a documented exit contract and tests.

- floor_guard.py — diff-scoped detection of the five moves that lower the
  bar (suppressions, skips, stubs, removed assertions, walked-down
  thresholds, new exception rows) over the merge base plus untracked
  files. Exit 0/1/2, and a 2 never reads as a 0. Exemption is a DECISIONS
  line naming the rule id and the path, not an ignore file; the report
  carries rule + file:line and never the matched text.
- guard_text.py — the fence for untrusted issue/PR/CI/web text. Envelope
  always (a clean scan is not proof), NFKC + format-character stripping so
  fullwidth and zero-width evasion still gets labelled, forged banners
  spliced, and a failed fetch exits non-zero with NO envelope on stdout.
- diff_scope.py — twelve SCOPE_* flags over the union of committed,
  working-tree and untracked changes, with SCOPE_ERROR=no_base|unmatched
  at exit 2 so "we could not look" can never present as a clean gate-off.
- decisions.py + one-way-doors.json — the DECISIONS log had a parser and
  no writer. append validates class, non-empty why and secret shapes, and
  refuses a line that matches the one-way keyword net without the class
  and a human source; active computes the non-superseded set; tally makes
  the adaptive lens gate deterministic across coordinators.
- egress.py — content-free hash-chained receipts for off-repo sends
  (0600 ledger, prev-linked, id bound to the record's own fields). write
  fails closed at exit 3, verify exits 3 on tamper, grants lists consents.
  Stated as forensic observability, not an exfiltration control.
- inventory.py — write/check for the sha256 integrity inventory in a run
  report, both the fenced and table shapes already in the tree. A check
  that verified nothing exits 2 rather than passing.
- deny-hook.sh — PreToolUse guard for read-write workers: HIGH-tier deny
  for root-class recursive deletes, --no-preserve-root, force-push to the
  default branch including +main refspecs, any force-push without a lease,
  and an orchestration reset; the Never list as ask; an Edit/Write
  boundary at the unit's own worktree with symlinks resolved. Fail-closed
  on unparseable input, and the tests prove each deny actually fires.
- hitl-loop.template.sh — the bounded human-in-the-loop reproduce loop the
  diagnosis playbook promises, with a --dry-run that needs no human.

Wiring is documented in each script's own header rather than in the
policy docs, so no existing file changes; the badge count is regenerated.

272 new contract tests, hermetic (real temp git repos where the subject is
a diff). Gate green: validate, 614 tests, ruff.
